title: Traffic accidents involving cyclists on Tanah Merah Coast Road
asked: Mr Cai Yinzhou asked for yearly figures from 2020 to 2025 on traffic accidents and cyclist-involved accidents along Tanah Merah Coast Road, the main causes of cyclist accidents and whether heavy vehicle movements and road debris are factors, and what steps the Ministry will take to prevent accidents on that stretch.
response: Ms Sim Ann said that between 2020 and 2025 there were on average around 20 accidents per year resulting in injuries or fatalities along Tanah Merah Coast Road, of which around nine per year involved cyclists. She listed the primary causes as cycling in a disorderly manner, cyclists and motorists failing to keep a proper lookout, and cyclists and motorists failing to have proper control of their vehicle or mobility device. She said the Traffic Police conduct regular enforcement at accident hotspots including Tanah Merah Coast Road, and that TP and LTA raise awareness of safe and gracious practices and work with the Singapore Cycling Federation and the People's Association to engage the cycling community and disseminate safety guidelines.
